purpose: Collect complete Linux native survivor logs independently of Kubernetes exec and SSM inline output limits

native.transport: SSM host Python + exact-container CRI; bounded base64 responses

cases: Real host Python transports binary output above the SSM inline limit
Reject process failures and inline-limit responses
Reject changed offset, total size, digest and file contents
Reject truncated, corrupt and invalid base64 chunks
Reject unsupported OS, incomplete container identity and unbounded sizes

limitations: Embedded remote Python program executed by native and local tests but not separately instrumented by coverage.py

placementCollectorValidation.state: passed; correctly preserved a failed traffic qualification
